metadata.title: Presenting a proof of the Kannan-Lovasz-Simonovits conjecture
metadata.abstract: Together with Bourgain's slicing problem and the variance conjecture, the Kannan-Lovász-Simonovits (KLS) conjecture has been a driving force for mathematical developments in high dimensional geometry in recent decades. We present here a proof of this conjecture. The crucial step in the proof is the very recent criterion from Song and Zhang involving high-order derivatives of tilt averages.

analysis.progressType: KLS 猜想的高阶 tilt 判据证明
analysis.workSummary: 作者提出 Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits 猜想证明，关键使用 Song–Zhang 最新的 tilt-average 高阶导数判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 若正文的高阶控制成立，将解决高维凸几何的核心猜想。
analysis.limitations: 须核对判据的所有适用条件及导数界，不能只凭摘要把证明视为公认结论。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确声明多数证明和数学想法由 ChatGPT 找到；主要例外是 suspension 思路由作者建议，作者主要理解这些证明并改善表述。
